description: This file defines a Java interface for a repository managing 'Curso' entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository, and includes custom query methods for retrieving courses by name and by professor.

classes.name: CursoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing 'Curso' entities, providing basic CRUD operations and custom queries.

methods.name: findByNomCurso
methods.description: Finds a course entity by its name.

methods.name: findAllByProfesor
methods.description: Retrieves a list of courses associated with a specific professor.
